Paper title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
Contribution / review note: Introduces anisotropic 3D Gaussians, interleaved optimization and density control, and visibility-aware differentiable rasterization.
Input → output: 多视角 RGB、相机位姿与 SfM 稀疏点 → 每场景优化的 3D Gaussians，可实时合成新视角

Paper title: A Survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: A broad, frequently revised field overview; use its taxonomy and references as a map into primary papers.
Additional review branches: Representation; Rendering; Reconstruction; SLAM; Dynamic 3DGS; Large-scale; Feed-forward; Applications
Input → output: 3DGS 论文与资源 → 方法分类、发展脉络、挑战与应用综述

Paper title: 3D Gaussian Splatting: Survey, Technologies, Challenges, and Opportunities
Contribution / review note: Organizes optimization, technical modules, applications, challenges, and opportunities across 3DGS.
Additional review branches: Representation; Rendering; Reconstruction; SLAM; Dynamic 3DGS; Large-scale; Feed-forward; Applications
Input → output: 领域论文与技术模块 → 3DGS 技术、应用、挑战及机会的分类

Paper title: A Survey on 3D Gaussian Splatting Applications: Segmentation, Editing, and Generation
Contribution / review note: Recent application-focused review of segmentation, editing, generation, supervision, benchmarks, and evaluation.
Input → output: 分割、编辑、生成等应用论文 → 应用分类、监督方式、数据集与评估综述

Paper title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis
Contribution / review note: Early dynamic 3DGS work that jointly models view synthesis and dense 6-DoF tracking with persistent Gaussians.
Input → output: 动态多视角视频及相机轨迹 → 持久动态 Gaussians、场景运动与动态视图合成

Paper title: Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
Contribution / review note: Uses canonical Gaussians with a learned deformation field to reconstruct monocular dynamic scenes.
Input → output: 单目动态视频与相机位姿 → canonical Gaussians + 形变场，支持时间相关的新视角

Paper title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering
Contribution / review note: Extends 3DGS to dynamic scenes with a time-conditioned deformation representation and real-time rendering.
Input → output: 带时间戳的动态多视角视频 → 时变 Gaussians/形变表示与实时动态渲染

Paper title: GaussianDreamer: Fast Generation from Text to 3D Gaussians by Bridging 2D and 3D Diffusion Models
Contribution / review note: Connects 2D and 3D diffusion priors for text-to-3D Gaussian asset generation.
Input → output: 文本提示与 2D/3D 扩散先验 → 生成式 3D Gaussian 资产

Paper title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation
Contribution / review note: Uses Gaussian optimization and mesh extraction for efficient image- and text-conditioned 3D content creation.
Input → output: 文本/图像条件与生成先验 → 优化的 3D Gaussians，并可提取网格

Paper title: Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Addresses scale changes and aliasing with 3D smoothing and a 2D Mip filter.
Input → output: 已训练 3DGS 与目标视角/尺度 → 3D 平滑和 2D Mip 滤波后的抗锯齿渲染

Paper title: LightGaussian: Unbounded 3D Gaussian Compression with 15x Reduction and 200+ FPS
Contribution / review note: Combines pruning, distillation, and vector quantization to reduce model size and speed rendering.
Input → output: 已优化场景 Gaussians → 剪枝、蒸馏和向量量化后的紧凑模型

Paper title: SuGaR: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Mesh Reconstruction and High-Quality Mesh Rendering
Contribution / review note: Regularizes Gaussians toward surfaces and supports efficient mesh extraction and mesh-compatible rendering.
Input → output: 多视角图像、相机位姿/SfM → 表面对齐 Gaussians 与可提取网格

Paper title: CompGS: Smaller and Faster Gaussian Splatting with Vector Quantization
Contribution / review note: Compresses Gaussian parameters with vector quantization to reduce storage and improve rendering efficiency.
Input → output: 已训练 3DGS → 向量量化的紧凑表示，降低存储与渲染开销

Paper title: Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
Contribution / review note: Replaces unconstrained per-view Gaussian growth with structured anchors and view-adaptive local Gaussians.
Input → output: 多视角图像与 SfM 初始化 → 结构化 anchors 和视角自适应 Gaussians

Paper title: SparseGS: Sparse View Synthesis using 3D Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Uses depth priors and unseen-view regularization to reduce floaters and collapse under sparse input views.
Input → output: 稀疏位姿图像与深度先验 → 带稀疏视图正则的场景 Gaussians/新视角

Paper title: FSGS: Real-Time Few-shot View Synthesis using Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Targets few-shot novel-view synthesis and demonstrates reconstruction from very few training views.
Input → output: 少量已标定视图 → 几何正则化的场景级 Gaussians 与少视图新视角合成

Paper title: pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
Contribution / review note: Predicts a Gaussian scene feed-forward from image pairs for generalizable reconstruction.
Input → output: 图像对 → 前馈预测的 3D Gaussians，可渲染新视角

Paper title: MVSplat: Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-View Images
Contribution / review note: Uses plane-swept cost volumes to predict clean Gaussians feed-forward from sparse views.
Input → output: 稀疏标定多视图 → plane-sweep cost volume 与前馈 Gaussians/新视角

Paper title: StopThePop: Sorted Gaussian Splatting for View-Consistent Real-time Rendering
Contribution / review note: Improves depth ordering to reduce popping and blending artifacts as the camera moves.
Input → output: 已训练 Gaussians 与相机视角 → 更一致的深度排序和实时合成

Paper title: SA-GS: Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Anti-Aliasing
Contribution / review note: Adds test-time scale-adaptive filtering and pixel integration for anti-aliasing pretrained splats.
Input → output: 已训练 3DGS 与目标像素尺度 → scale-adaptive filtering 后的抗锯齿图像

Paper title: GaussianPro: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Progressive Propagation
Contribution / review note: Progressively propagates geometry to improve reconstruction where SfM initialization is sparse or weak.
Input → output: 稀疏图像/SfM 初始化 → 逐步传播几何并优化的 Gaussians 与新视角

Paper title: Gaussian Opacity Fields: Efficient Adaptive Surface Reconstruction in Unbounded Scenes
Contribution / review note: Builds an opacity field over Gaussians for adaptive, efficient surface reconstruction in unbounded scenes.
Input → output: 已训练场景 Gaussians 与多视角观测 → opacity field 和自适应表面/网格

Paper title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields
Contribution / review note: Uses oriented planar Gaussian disks and ray-splat intersections to improve geometric consistency and surface reconstruction.
Input → output: 标定多视角图像 → 定向 2D Gaussian disks、几何一致的新视角与表面/深度

Paper title: GS-SLAM: Dense Visual SLAM with 3D Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Introduces a real-time splatting map representation into dense visual SLAM.
Input → output: 连续相机图像/位姿观测 → 相机跟踪、稠密 Gaussian 地图与在线渲染

Paper title: Photo-SLAM: Real-time Simultaneous Localization and Photorealistic Mapping for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras
Contribution / review note: Combines visual SLAM with photorealistic Gaussian mapping across common camera setups.
Input → output: 单目/双目/RGB-D 相机流 → 实时定位与 photorealistic Gaussian mapping

Paper title: Gaussian Splatting SLAM
Contribution / review note: Adapts 3DGS to monocular SLAM and unifies tracking, mapping, and rendering in a Gaussian scene representation.
Input → output: 单目图像序列 → 联合相机跟踪、Gaussian 场景地图与可渲染结果

Paper title: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM
Contribution / review note: Uses explicit volumetric Gaussians for dense reconstruction from an unposed RGB-D stream.
Input → output: RGB-D 视频流 → 相机位姿与稠密 3D Gaussian 地图

Paper title: Gaussian-SLAM: Photo-realistic Dense SLAM with Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Explores dense photorealistic SLAM with 3DGS as the scene representation.
Input → output: 相机图像序列 → Gaussian 表示的稠密 SLAM 地图、位姿估计与渲染

Paper title: RTG-SLAM: Real-time 3D Reconstruction at Scale using Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Targets real-time reconstruction at scale using a Gaussian SLAM pipeline.
Input → output: 实时相机/SLAM 输入 → 规模化 Gaussian 重建地图与定位/渲染

Paper title: Gaussian Grouping: Segment and Edit Anything in 3D Scenes
Contribution / review note: Lifts 2D segmentation cues into 3D Gaussians for open-world object grouping and scene editing.
Input → output: 多视角场景及 2D 分割线索 → 3D Gaussian 实例分组、分割和可编辑场景

Paper title: Feature 3DGS: Supercharging 3D Gaussian Splatting to Enable Distilled Feature Fields
Contribution / review note: Distills 2D foundation-model features into Gaussians for open-vocabulary 3D feature fields.
Input → output: 多视角图像与预训练特征 → 蒸馏到 Gaussians 的 3D feature field

Paper title: LangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Encodes language-aligned features in Gaussians for open-vocabulary spatial queries.
Input → output: 带位姿图像及语言/视觉特征 → 每个 Gaussian 的语言表征与开放词汇空间查询

Paper title: GaussianEditor: Swift and Controllable 3D Editing with Gaussian Splatting
Contribution / review note: Provides controllable editing operations on Gaussian scenes while preserving multi-view consistency.
Input → output: 预训练 3DGS 与文本/掩码/语义编辑指令 → 可控修改后的 Gaussian 场景

Paper title: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo
Contribution / review note: Reframes Gaussian density control as an MCMC process to reduce hand-designed densification heuristics.
Input → output: 多视角图像与 SfM 初始化 → 以 MCMC 密度控制优化的 3D Gaussians

Paper title: Mini-Splatting: Representing Scenes with a Constrained Number of Gaussians
Contribution / review note: Studies compact scene representations under a constrained Gaussian budget.
Input → output: 多视角观测与受限 Gaussian 数量预算 → 预算约束下优化的场景表示

Paper title: HAC: Hash-grid Assisted Context for 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression
Contribution / review note: Uses spatial context and entropy coding to compress Gaussian attributes.
Input → output: 已训练场景 Gaussians → hash-grid context 辅助的上下文建模与熵编码表示

Paper title: ContextGS: Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting with Anchor Level Context Model
Contribution / review note: Models anchor-level context to improve compact Gaussian representation and coding.
Input → output: 已训练 3DGS/anchors → anchor-level context modeling 的紧凑编码

Paper title: Taming 3DGS: High-Quality Radiance Fields with Limited Resources
Contribution / review note: Explores efficient 3DGS training and representation under constrained compute and memory.
Input → output: 多视角训练数据与受限算力/显存 → 资源约束下训练的高质量 Gaussian radiance field

Paper title: CityGaussian: Real-time High-quality Large-Scale Scene Rendering with Gaussians
Contribution / review note: Uses divide-and-conquer scene partitioning and level of detail for city-scale reconstruction and rendering.
Input → output: 城市级多视图图像/分块数据 → 分区 Gaussians、LOD 与实时大场景渲染

Paper title: VastGaussian: Vast 3D Gaussians for Large Scene Reconstruction
Contribution / review note: Partitions large scenes for parallel optimization and models appearance variation at scale.
Input → output: 大范围多视角图像 → 分块/并行优化的城市级 Gaussians 与外观变化渲染

Paper title: Octree-GS: Towards Consistent Real-time Rendering with LOD-Structured 3D Gaussians
Contribution / review note: Uses octree and level-of-detail structure for consistent real-time rendering across scene scales.
Input → output: 已训练/重建的 Gaussians → octree/LOD 层次与跨尺度一致实时渲染

Paper title: On Scaling Up 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
Contribution / review note: Presents Grendel, a distributed multi-GPU system for scaling 3DGS training to large scenes.
Input → output: 多视角图像与匹配/位姿数据 → Grendel 多 GPU 分布式优化的场景 Gaussians

Paper title: 4D Gaussian Splatting: Modeling Dynamic Scenes with Native 4D Primitives
Contribution / review note: Models space-time jointly with native 4D Gaussian primitives instead of relying only on deformation of 3D Gaussians.
Input → output: 带时间戳的动态多视角观测 → 原生 4D Gaussian 时空表示与时间条件渲染

Paper title: Hybrid 3D-4D Gaussian Splatting for Fast Dynamic Scene Representation
Contribution / review note: Keeps static regions in 3D Gaussians and assigns native 4D Gaussians to dynamic regions.
Input → output: 动态序列 → 静态区域 3D Gaussians + 动态区域原生 4D Gaussians

Paper title: Disentangled 4D Gaussian Splatting: Rendering High-Resolution Dynamic World at 343 FPS
Contribution / review note: Separates spatial and temporal components to reduce redundant 4D computations.
Input → output: 动态视频序列 → 空间/时间解耦的 4D Gaussians 与高分辨率动态渲染

Paper title: Compression in 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Survey of Methods, Trends, and Future Directions
Contribution / review note: Dedicated taxonomy and comparison of 3DGS compression methods and deployment trade-offs.
Input → output: 3DGS 压缩论文与基准 → 压缩方法分类、趋势及部署比较

Paper title: Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction of Unordered Input with Global Consistency
Contribution / review note: Combines immediate feedback, unordered image matching, loop closure, and progressive hierarchy for large captures.
Input → output: 无序采集图像 → 逐步重建、全局一致 Gaussians 与层次化大场景结果
